model based control can be successfully applied to lightweight robots, and the proposed approach is suitable for a structured controller design for such robots.
we have successfully derived a suitable model for the lightweight robot, we have identified the model parameters and have successfully validated the model-based control scheme.
the proposed model based controller is capable to control the robot in a compliant manner and that it is possible to identify the robot model based on the proposed approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of model-based controllers and parameter identification methods for lightweight robots, and the development of a toolbox for the considered robotic system.
the development of a model-based control scheme for a lightweight robot, which can be used for compliant motion control.
the design, implementation and experimental validation of a structured approach for the derivation of suitable robot models for model based control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a structured approach to controller design is feasible, but requires a high level of effort, which has to be considered for future applications.
the model-based controller outperforms the classical PID controller in terms of tracking performance.
the proposed approach is suitable for model-based controller derivation, but that further work is required to improve the model identification.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that model-based control is a feasible approach for the considered robot, and that the derived models can be identified with good results.
the presented model-based control approach is a promising way to achieve close and compliant tracking, which is required for many robotic tasks.
we have shown how to model and control lightweight robots, and that the proposed model-based control approach is able to improve the tracking performance of a robot.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed approach allows to derive a model-based controller for a lightweight robot in a straightforward way.
model-based control is a viable approach for compliant tracking of desired trajectories.
